niche: connected TV and streaming advertising agency
prompt_text: What is the best connected TV advertising agency?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single “best” connected TV (CTV) advertising agency — the right partner depends on your goals, budget, geography, creative needs, data/measurement requirements, and whether you want programmatic or direct platform buys. Below is a practical way to think about options and a short list of reputable players to consider.

Top places to look
- Global/holding-company media agencies (full-service, good for big/brand + performance campaigns)
  - WPP (Mindshare, MediaCom, Wavemaker)
  - Omnicom (OMD, PHD)
  - Publicis (Starcom, Zenith)
  - Dentsu (Carat, iProspect)
  - IPG (Initiative, MAGNA)
- Specialist CTV/advanced-video agencies and platforms (deep technical expertise / programmatic & measurement)
  - The Trade Desk (DSP — programmatic buying engine many agencies use)
  - Amobee, Tremor Video, Simulmedia, Cadent — programmatic/TV-specific buying platforms and agencies
  - Innovid — creative, ad serving and measurement for CTV
  - Roku Advertising, Amazon Ads (Fire TV), Samsung Ads — platform teams for direct buys on their inventories

How to choose
- Objective: brand awareness (broad reach + premium inventory) vs performance (CPA/ROAS-driven).
- Inventory & placement needs: streaming app premieres, platform-specific (Roku, Fire TV), linear/advanced TV.
- Targeting & data: do you need household-level, programmatic frequency control, or advanced audience segments?
- Measurement & attribution: do you need MTA, incrementality testing, cross-screen attribution, or third‑party verification?
- Creative capabilities: do you need dynamic/interactive CTV creative or in-stream video only?
- Transparency & fees: programmatic fees, data fees, reporting cadence.
- Geography & scale: local, national, or global reach.

Questions to ask a prospective agency
- Which DSPs/platforms do you use and why?
- Can you show CTV case studies for my industry and objective?
- How do you measure reach, frequency and incremental impact?
- What inventory sources and publishers do you access?
- How will creative be adapted for CTV (lengths, interactivity, VCR)?
- What are your billing and fee structures?

If you tell me your industry, budget, target markets, and primary objective (brand vs performance), I can recommend 3–5 agencies or platforms that are a strong fit for your needs.
